about: The Epistle of the formulary “Purification of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I send My angel, and he will prepare the way before My face. And at once the Ruler, whom you seek, will come to His temple, and the Angel of the covenant, whom you desire. Behold, He comes, says the Lord of hosts. And who will be able to think of the day of His coming, and who will stand to see Him? For He is like a refining fire, and like the fullers’ herb; and He will sit refining and cleansing silver, and He will purge the sons of Levi and purify them like gold and like silver; and they will be offering sacrifices to the Lord in justice. And the sacrifice of Judah and of Jerusalem will please the Lord, as in days long past and as in the ancient years, says the Lord almighty.
